in_hebrew.name: Aldwon
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Old friend, wise counselor
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Aldwon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The Old English name Aldwon is derived from two Old English words: ‘ald’, meaning old, and ‘wean’, meaning friend. This name was often given to someone who had been a loyal companion for a long time or someone who was wise and provided good counsel.
